title: Share and discover 3D AI characters
author: solo_solipsist
selftext: Hi there AI Gamedevs!  I've been thinking about the AI assistant / chatbot space a lot recently, and was inspired by the launch of Grok's Ani and Whispers from the Star.  IMO it feels like there's not really a good spot to find characters that are ready to go with 3D assets and personality, so I created this landing page to collect some feedback and see if other people feel the same way.  So -- what do you think?  I'd love to hear any and all opinions!

comments.author: TruWaves
comments.body: Why would anyone buy ai generated characters that you can regenerate with meshy, tripo3d, stableprojectorz etc from the images on your site?

replies.author: solo_solipsist
replies.body: The idea isn't that the characters are AI generated, but that they're human creations packaged for use as LLM powered characters.  So with meshy, tripo, etc, you get a textured mesh which isn't quite "game ready".  What I'd like to see is somewhere to get everything all together -- mesh, textures, rig, animation, separated clothing / props and personality.
